comparison.objective: Use a scoop and the tray wall to transfer 16 mm beads into a bowl.
comparison.physical_skill: Granular collection through scoop-wall interaction, not bimanual precision hammering or notch fracture.
comparison.success_condition: Beads are transferred to the bowl; the body reports seven in the demo but supplies no complete scoring thresholds.
comparison.reason: Loose-object scooping is meaningfully different from fracturing retained insert tangs and recovering each fragment.
